daily.protocol: Train early 65% calendar dates of 2018, purge label boundary, validate remaining 2018, frozen-model test all eligible 2019 origins. No final refit; group lags by year and pond.
daily.uncertainty: Descriptive percentile bootstrap of six 2019 pond identifiers, 2000 resamples; not national population confidence.

vibrio.protocol: Train 2022-2023; validate 2024; frozen test 2025. No random splits. All sampling dates/campaigns stay within a year block. Pond IDs unavailable; cannot certify unseen-pond generalization.
vibrio.target: Contemporaneous total genus-level log10(CFU/mL+1), not disease, species-specific pathogen, future outbreak or sensor-failure label.

economics.basis: 2018-2019 nominal VND. Energy includes crop fuel and electricity; excludes sensor-specific attribution. No inflation conversion, causal trial/control claim, measured monitoring cost or asserted savings.

mangrove.basis: Repeated before/after water exchange at three tides; household, age and replicate nesting. Descriptive only, no causal intervention or independent n=180 claim.

weekly_audit.nitrogen_basis: TAN header lacks an explicit unit/basis; no inferred free-ammonia conversion.
